business_problem: HOLYWATER TECH wanted to produce long-form fantasy video content faster and more consistently, but traditional filming and fragmented AI tools made it hard to keep characters, settings, and sound synchronized across hundreds of scenes.
solution_summary: HOLYWATER TECH uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: HOLYWATER TECH wanted to produce long-form fantasy video content faster and more consistently, but traditional filming and fragmented AI tools made it hard to keep characters, settings, and sound synchronized across hundreds of scenes. Gemini platform hosts the end-to-end production pipeline and the specialized agents that turn books into production bibles, serving as the serving layer. Imagen generates high-quality storyboards that preserve visual continuity during pre-production and shot iteration, serving as the compute layer. Veo turns storyboard references into final cinematic video with synchronized audio and realistic motion, serving as the compute layer. BigQuery stores product and audience-engagement data so the company can evaluate how AI-generated content performs, serving as the storage layer.
